prompt: The repository is a brand-asset workspace: `brief/brand.json` carries the palette, the identity descriptor and the constraint thresholds, `brief/examples.json` records measurements the author observed from three example specs on the live model, and `generation/spec.json` is the spec you must deliver. Your spec is replayed against the real image model and graded on what comes back, not on a description: at most two variants for a 1024x1024 hero render, the first that conforms wins. A conforming render is a flat image on the brief's background colour, holding the brief's accent colour in at least 3 percent of the frame, with at most 12 colours covering 95 percent of it, quiet corners, nothing in the outer 10 percent border, and no pixel of the forbidden colour. Write prompts that state the palette and composition explicitly and pin the model and seed; `bun run tools/check-spec.mjs generation/spec.json` validates the shape of what you hand in.

requirements: live image model reached over the network, with the token bucket and model list recorded in the brief
palette, identity descriptor and constraint thresholds disclosed in brief/brand.json
measurements from real renders of example specs shipped in brief/examples.json
generation spec replayed by the harness, one request per variant, at most two variants per target
per-image measurements: palette spread, background share, accent share, corner spread, border share, forbidden share

falsifiableChecks.assertion: The delivered spec names an allowed model, pins a distinct numeric seed per variant, declares its canvas, and stays inside the two-variant budget.
The harness obtained at least one image from the live service using the delivered prompt, model and seed.
The accepted render uses at most 12 distinct colours to cover 95 percent of its pixels.
The accepted render holds at least 60 percent background, a corner luma spread of at most 20, and at most 10 percent non-background pixels in the outer border.
The accepted render contains the brief accent in at least 3 percent of its pixels and the forbidden colour in at most 1 percent.
No more than two variants were requested for the target.

evidence: Representative verification results or explicit unavailable checks
Hierarchy boundary and selected specialist rationale
Representative success, negative-path, and recovery verification
hierarchy boundary and specialist selection rationale
source/version boundary when facts can drift

requiredEvidence: recorded model identity and the exact prompt, seed and canvas per variant
rendered images and their measured palette, background, accent, corner, border and exclusion values
which variant was accepted and which constraints it satisfied
